title: Sing
original_lyrics:
[verse]
It's late in the evening
Glass on the side
I've been sat with you
For most of the night
Ignoring everybody here
We wish they would disappear
So maybe we could get down now
I don't wanna know
If you're getting ahead of the program
I want you to be mine, lady
To hold your body close
Take another step

[intro]
For the longest time, lady
I need you darling

[chorus]
If you feel you're falling
Won't you let me know
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
If you love me, come on, get involved
Feel it rushing through you
From your head to toe
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
(Sing)
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh oh
(Louder)
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh oh
(Sing)
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
This love is ablaze
I saw flames from the side of the stage
And the fire brigade comes

[intro]
Until then, we got nothing to say
And nothing to know

[bridge]
And maybe something to smoke
Let it go until
Our roads are changed
Singing "We Found Love"

[intro]
I don't really know what
I'm supposed to say

[bridge]
Then hope and pray
I told her my name
And said "it's nice to meet ya"
And then she handed me bottle
Of water filled with tequila
I already know that she's keeper
Just from this one small
Act of kindness
I'm in deep
If anybody find out
I'm meant to drive home

[bridge]
Not sobering up
We just sit on the couch
One thing led to another
Now she's kissing my mouth
I need you darling

[chorus]
If you feel you're falling
Won't you let me know
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
If you love me, come on, get involved
Feel it rushing through you
From your head to toe
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
(Sing)
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh oh
(Louder)
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh oh
(Sing)
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh
Oh oh oh oh, oh oh oh oh

[chorus]
All the guys in here
Don't even wanna dance

[chorus]
All that I can hear
Is music from the back

[chorus]
Found you hiding here
So won't you take my hand, darling

[chorus]
(Sing)
I need you darling

[chorus]
If you feel you're falling
Won't you let me know (louder)
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
(Sing)
If you love me, come on, get involved
Feel it rushing through you
From your head to toe (louder)
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh
Oh oh oh, oh oh oh (sing)
